新增:
选择图片
点按图片查看大图，点按圆圈选中；拖动圆圈可连续选择，双指缩放可调整每行数量；已选图片可拖动排序；支持拍照、编辑和系统相册的收藏

只看楼主与倒序
楼层标题旁新增倒序按钮；楼层标题移入顶栏后，顶栏显示只看楼主与倒序开关
改进:
按压反馈
全应用的按压效果统一；悬浮的玻璃按钮按下时放大，并在触点处高亮；菜单从按下的按钮展开

列表滚动
高刷新率手机上，列表慢速滚动时保持高帧率

帖子卡片
底部按钮行的上下间距一致；回复的作者名改为次要文字颜色

标签栏
搜索页改用玻璃标签栏，宽度与搜索框一致；切换精华分类时，标签名称与宽度平滑过渡
修复: 部分吧的头像显示为贴吧默认图标
打开图片或视频时，屏幕亮度升高
帖子卡片上的分享按钮，以及搜索结果卡片底部的按钮无法使用
快速滑动切换首页标签后，点按底栏无法切换到对应页面
屏幕较窄或显示大小较大时，关注的吧只显示一列
空页面与错误页面的内容没有居中
吧内切换精华分类或排序后，列表没有加载提示
帖子中切换只看楼主或倒序时，阅读位置改变
经典样式下，顶栏按钮没有按压反馈
标签选项菜单收起时，箭头转回有延迟
更新页面不显示当前版本的更新说明
提示条中的按钮离文字过近，颜色与文字不一致

New:
Picking pictures
Tap a picture to view it large, and its circle to pick it; drag from a circle to pick several, and pinch to change how many fit in a row; picked pictures can be dragged into order; taking photos, editing and the system gallery's favorites are supported

Author's posts and newest first
A newest-first button sits beside the floors' heading; once the heading moves into the top bar, the bar shows switches for both
Improved:
Pressing
Presses look the same across the app; floating glass buttons grow and light up where they are touched; menus open out of the button pressed

Scrolling
On phones with a high refresh rate, lists keep a high frame rate when scrolled slowly

Thread cards
The row of buttons at the bottom has even spacing above and below; a reply's author name uses the secondary text color

Tabs
Search uses the glass tab bar, as wide as the search field; picking a class of good threads changes the tab's name and width smoothly

The share button on thread cards, and the buttons at the bottom of search result cards, didn't work
After quickly swiping between home tabs, tapping the bottom bar didn't switch to that page

Empty and error screens weren't centered
Switching a forum's class of good threads or its order showed no loading
Switching to the author's posts or the other order in a thread moved the reading position
In the classic style, top bar buttons showed no press
A tab's options arrow turned back late when its menu closed
The update page didn't show the installed version's notes
A notice's button sat too close to its text, in a color that didn't match
